items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: Tesla's new Roadster will be a tiny part of its business, but its launch sent the stock surging. Here's why.
items.summary: Tesla stock surged 5% as Elon Musk unveiled a Roadster with SpaceX thrusters, showing off Tesla's engineering chops.

items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: With Tesla Roadster debut, Elon Musk shows "flying cars are real"
items.summary: Elon Musk unveils Tesla's new Roadster, which uses high-pressure air thrusters to leave the road entirely during a livestreamed event at his SpaceX facility in Texas.

items.label: Tesla
items.headline: Tesla sales smash Wall Street's expectations
items.summary: Tesla posted record sales in Q3 last year as buyers rushed to take advantage of the $7,500 tax credit for new EVs, which expired in September 2025.
